submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Cooking for a Village While Recovering"
finding.problem: "My husband said 'you're home now, just cook small.' I can't stand at the pot for 30 minutes. The soup pot is heavier than my baby."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 25-yr-old Kano mom; omugwo came late; she's expected to start making family meals (African soups take hours of standing); partner assumes she's "fine now."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone angle (delegation + 10-min no-stand meals) → bundle with One-Handed Nutrition.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
